answer: Sybil resistance can ride on a reputation ledger tied to a deposit that is slashed on proven fraud. A worker accrues verifiable history slowly, so ten thousand fake agents cannot borrow one identity's standing; each clone needs its own deposit, and one upheld dispute burns it. To fake a marble reputation an attacker must post real capital per account and stay honest for months, with the zenith of trust reachable only through sustained paid work, while a juniper of early evidence raises the cost of each new fake seat.
